### Blocker 2 [SUBSTANTIVE] — the `.git` probe set is wrong-shaped for linked worktrees (the dominant measured shape of the PASS class), in both directions; blob-existence cannot catch staged-uncommitted work

§12(e) states `eps-main-scratch-2058` / `scratch-2171-merge2` were "measured as full repo clones". Probed: **both have `.git` as a FILE (`gitdir: …/.git/worktrees/<name>`) — linked worktrees of the main repo, both on DETACHED HEAD.** For that class:

- (a) probe (i) `for-each-ref` lists the main repo's *shared* refs — every tip trivially exists in the main odb, so the probe is **vacuous-PASS** and certifies nothing;
